race.comment: JUST PRECIOUS (9) is the one to beat after winning three straight. She drops to 52kg with rise to Open grade, which will make her an absolute handful to hold out late. ESJAY (3) is a model of consistency for the Webster camp and finds a nice race to get back into the winner's circle. Just missed two back in the LR Tattersall's Members Cup, before running headfirst into the in-form Brindavan. He's a track and trip specialist, so have to take very seriously. POCKET FULL (10) has found the line nicely in both runs back and should be hitting his straps now third-up. Hasn't won for a long time but gets in light and is drawn low. Not underestimating. SPACE TRACKER (6) finished just behind ESJAY last time here in the Tattersall's but doesn't meet him as well at the weights this time. Respecting but needs to find a bit more. G1 winner PORT LOCKROY (2) returns and is worth keeping in mind on peak figures despite it being a while between drinks.
